meta.why: W3 C17。40 条题、四类各 10。参考值一律由参考 SQL 跑出来，不用模型给的数字（防自证）。
meta.discipline: 问题里不出现「上个月」「最近 30 天」这类相对时间——参考值会随执行日漂移，评测就不可复跑。要测相对时间理解，只能拿答案的时间边界人工看。

modes.value: 答案里出现与参考值偏差 ≤ tolerance 的数字（含量级换算）即命中
modes.series: 多值结果，参考值集合被答案覆盖 ≥ 80% 即命中
modes.caveat: 既要数字命中，又要提到该题固有的口径限制（caveatKeywords 任一命中）
modes.refuse: 必须明确说数据不存在/无法计算，不给编造的数字

cases.question: 买过硬件的客户里，有多少人后来订阅了 SaaS 服务？
sql: JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
JOIN product_variants pv ON pv.id = oi.variant_id
JOIN products p ON p.id = pv.product_id
JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id
LEFT JOIN categories parent ON parent.id = c.parent_id
cases.note: 跨线分析：要穿 order_items → variants → products → categories 两层才到一级品类

cases.question: 哪个获客渠道带来的成交额最高？
sql: SELECT round(sum(o.total_amount - o.discount_amount))::bigint AS v, ch.name
FROM orders o JOIN channels ch ON ch.id = o.channel_id
GROUP BY ch.name ORDER BY 1 DESC LIMIT 1
cases.note: 答案里应同时出现渠道名（付费广告）与该渠道金额；value 只校验金额

cases.question: 退货率最高的 5 个商品是哪些？
sql: SELECT round(100.0 * coalesce(sum(r.quantity), 0) / nullif(sum(oi.quantity), 0), 1)::float AS v, p.name
JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id
JOIN product_variants pv ON pv.id = oi.variant_id
JOIN products p ON p.id = pv.product_id
LEFT JOIN returns r ON r.order_item_id = oi.id
GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY 1 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1
cases.note: 开放题：任何 5 个商品都可辩护，且行列两种口径都成立（13.3% vs 18.8%），唯一稳定的判据是「有没有指出样本量/排名不稳」。第一次跑时判它 18.8% 未命中，复核发现模型的口径更严谨（按明细行 + 样本≥20 过滤），属于判据误判。

cases.question: 我们的复购率是多少？
sql: SELECT round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE cnt >= 2) / count(*), 1)::float AS v
FROM (SELECT customer_id, count(*) AS cnt FROM orders WHERE status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY 1) t
cases.note: 复购率至少两种算法（客户维度 / 订单维度），必须说明用的是哪种

cases.question: 哪个品类最赚钱？
sql: / NULLIF(sum(oi.subtotal) OVER (PARTITION BY oi.order_id), 0) AS net
JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id
JOIN product_variants pv ON pv.id = oi.variant_id
JOIN products p ON p.id = pv.product_id
SELECT oi.id AS item_id, sum(r.refund_amount) AS amt
FROM returns r JOIN order_items oi ON oi.id = r.order_item_id
LEFT JOIN refund ON refund.item_id = share.item_id
JOIN categories c ON c.id = share.category_id
LEFT JOIN categories parent ON parent.id = c.parent_id
GROUP BY COALESCE(parent.name, c.name) ORDER BY 1 DESC LIMIT 1
cases.note: 陷阱：库里没有成本字段，「赚钱」只能等于「收入最高」，必须说清。参考值取更严格的「净营收」= 订单折扣分摊后再扣退货退款；不扣退款的版本作为备选。第一版直加 subtotal（原价），第二版没扣退款，两次都是模型比我严谨。

sql: / NULLIF(sum(oi.subtotal) OVER (PARTITION BY oi.order_id), 0) AS net
JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id
JOIN product_variants pv ON pv.id = oi.variant_id
JOIN products p ON p.id = pv.product_id
SELECT round(sum(share.net))::bigint AS v, COALESCE(parent.name, c.name) AS cat
JOIN categories c ON c.id = share.category_id
LEFT JOIN categories parent ON parent.id = c.parent_id
GROUP BY COALESCE(parent.name, c.name) ORDER BY 1 DESC LIMIT 1
alts.note: 只扣订单折扣、未扣退货退款（第二版参考 SQL 的口径）
